text: England chased 185 in 13.1 overs on the Gold Coast to beat Australia in the second T20I and level the series.
Gukesh and Sindarov, both 20, begin their 14-game world championship match in Geneva today, with commentary from Peter Leko and Peter Svidler on FIDE's YouTube channel.
The Players Championship Finals run 27 to 29 November in Minehead without Luke Littler, Nathan Aspinall or Josh Rock; Stephen Bunting opens against Max Hopp.
Tyson Fury fights Anthony Joshua at Cardiff's Principality Stadium on 11 December, streaming live on Netflix.
Kansas City Current beat Washington Spirit 2-1 to win their first NWSL title, Debinha scoring in stoppage time and the Spirit losing a third straight final.
Carlos Alcaraz beat Alexander Zverev 6-2 7-6 to win the ATP Finals for the first time.
Gerwyn Price beat Gian van Veen 16-11 to win the Grand Slam of Darts, ending a four-year wait for a major.
